scope: Original English 2023 Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required standard scoring two-player Rival, plus optional base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; identify but exclude 10 Rise of Ix compatibility contracts. Exclude solo, optional Rival variants, six-player teams, cross-game expansions and later-product components. Apply relevant general/Uprising official FAQ dated 2025-01-13.

source_references: Main rules pp.3,16–18; text lines 101–178,849–932
Supplement pp.3–6; lines 156–426
checked_claims.detail: Original Uprising standard 2–4 players, a scoring two-player Rival, and optional standard CHOAM are distinguished from solo, optional Rival variants, six-player teams, cross-game expansions and the separate 10 Rise of Ix contracts. Component counts and starting deck agree.

source_references: Main rules pp.4–5; text lines 180–286
checked_claims.detail: Each full Conflict tier is shuffled before selection: 1 of 3 tier I, 5 of 9 tier II and all 4 tier III. Unused cards return unseen. Leader, deck, Row, Reserve, Objective, marker, cube, Agent, troop, water, Spy and common-bank initial locations and states agree.

source_references: Main rules pp.7–9; text lines 321–490
FAQ p.4 Spies
checked_claims.detail: Faction gain, entry payment before destination/card effects, matching access icon, occupied-space restriction, optional early Reveal, and Plot Intrigue timing are consistent. Already-gained legal preplacement Plot resources may pay entry; destination gains may not.

source_references: Main rules pp.12–13; text lines 645–737
FAQ p.3 Reveal turn
checked_claims.detail: Reveal, effects with freely interleaved Persuasion purchases and strength setting, then cleanup are ordered correctly; acquisition goes to discard and the Row refills immediately.

source_references: Main rules pp.13–15; text lines 739–847
Supplement p.5 Combat
checked_claims.detail: Intrigue passes must be consecutive; strength changes resolve immediately; units are required. Rewards use player count and ties. Winner first takes card face up, then performs mandatory match check. Troops go to supply, sandworms to bank, markers to zero. Makers precedes Recall/endgame check.

source_references: FAQ p.4 troops and Maker hooks
checked_claims.detail: Recruit from supply to garrison; Combat placement allows all troops recruited that turn plus up to two old garrison troops. Sandworms summon directly, require Hooks only when specified, obey Shield Wall and double rewards without doubling control or battle icons. Hooks are retained.

checked_claims.topic: Battle icons, acquire and trash rules
checked_claims.detail: Face-up matching Conflict/Objective pair must flip for one VP. Wild match is an Endgame option. Persuasion expires. Deck exhaustion reshuffles discard. Trashing origins, destination, Reserve return, optionality and cost/self-trash exceptions agree.

source_references: Main rules pp.7,15; text lines 321–338,825–847
FAQ pp.1–2 Alliance and Endgame
checked_claims.detail: Two-Influence VP can be lost/regained; four-Influence resource bonus is retained and can recur; Alliance VP follows token transfers. Gain-ties do not steal it, holder-loss ties can transfer it, and return-to-board loss is covered. Endgame trigger and resource tiebreak order agree.

source_references: FAQ pp.2–4 optional effects, Intrigue cards, Spies and Shield Wall
checked_claims.detail: Spy placement/recall optionality, post restrictions, supply exhaustion, access, separate Infiltrate/Gather Intelligence uses and immediate draw timing agree. Control visitation/defense origins agree. Arrow effects are once per turn with doubled Conflict reward exception. Intrigues are separate, hidden and discarded after use; stealing threshold is four.

source_references: Main rules p.14; text lines 792–805
FAQ p.1 Conflict
checked_claims.detail: All first-, second- and third-place ties, including three tied first in four players, use the printed reward reductions. No winner takes the card after a first-place tie.

Acquire effects occur once on acquisition. Fremen Bond uses other cards in play and can activate mutually. Recall Agent cannot recall the current Agent; retreat goes to garrison. Feyd, Jessica, Margot/Irulan, Shaddam timing and Spacing Guild’s Favor clarifications agree.

source_references: Main rules p.16; text lines 849–932; visually inspected publisher PDF p.16
FAQ pp.1,3 contract and Shaddam
checked_claims.detail: All 20 standard contracts are used with two face up and 18 in the bank; the separate 10 contrasting-back contracts are excluded. Four additional cards enter each deck and Shaddam is optional. Taking/refilling/exhaustion, named-space/Harvest/Immediate/Acquire The Spice Must Flow completion, mandatory multi-contract completion, contract ownership at placement, reward timing and face-down completed destination agree.

source_references: Supplement pp.3–4; text lines 156–281
FAQ p.3 Rivals
checked_claims.detail: Shared scoring Rival starts at zero with required components and Ornithopter Objective; human First Player alternates. Rival uses supply Agents, never Reveals, and continues until all Agents are used. Occupied conditional destinations cause redraw rather than alternate destination. Place Spy cards never consume an Agent. Hagal instructions replace space costs/effects. Troop, Spy, priority and Scheme handling agree.

source_references: Supplement pp.4–5; text lines 268–346
Supplement publisher PDF p.5 resource conversion diagram; supplied unannotated PNG viewed
checked_claims.detail: Swordmaster counts each Solari, spice, Intrigue and water as one with correct spend priority and leftovers. Afterwards every 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigues or 3 water buys a VP, visually verified. Rival gains Influence VP but not four-Influence bonuses; collects Maker bonus/base spice or summons, and applies its own Hooks/Wall conditions.

independence_statement: Fresh independent final source audit of the exact frozen iteration-09 snapshot. I read the complete snapshot and the three complete authorized text sources separately in bounded chunks, then checked necessary publisher visual evidence. I did not read any other summary version, previous audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers or grades, and did not communicate with readers. I did not edit the summary. Printed card/contract instructions are respected only to the extent supported by the supplied texts/PDF; no unsupported printed-card details were invented.
material_limitations: Supplied text and necessary unannotated PDF evidence are the audit authority. This is a rules-summary audit, not an inventory of every printed card/contract face; the summary correctly defers varying printed effects and rewards to the components.
